description: Aggregate dirty flag shared by every draft-state record the library reports through an OnDraftChanged parameter (TmCommentDraftState, TmChatDraftState, TmNotionCommentDraftState). Lets a consumer read the one dirty decision — 'would a reload, a navigation or a panel close throw something away?' — without caring which concrete record a component reports. The draft text itself is never carried; it reaches the consumer through the component's submit callbacks on commit.

members.name: HasUnsavedContent
members.description: Whether any draft slot currently holds content that would be lost on discard. Always false before the first user input; for an open edit it means the edited text differs from the original as it was when the edit started.
